stories.title: Eight rescued, firefighter injured in fire at south Mumbai residential building
stories.summary: Eight people, including two children, were rescued after a fire broke out at a four-storey residential building in south Mumbai in the early hours of Sunday. A firefighter sustained injuries during the rescue operation, officials said. 07 am at Hira Manzil, located on Gildar Lane near Navjivan Society in Mumbai Central.

stories.summary: The accused have been identified as Sudhakar Phatarpekar and his nephew Sai Phatarpekar. According to the police, complainant Sakshi Devsthali, 27, a homemaker from Nalasopara West, was seeking employment when Sudhakar, an acquaintance of her father, offered to secure her an airport job. Her husband works in the private sector.

stories.title: Western Railway motormen, train managers participate in WNC Navy Half Marathon
stories.summary: Train managers and motormen from Western Railway participated in the WNC Navy Half Marathon 2026 in Mumbai on Sunday, November 22, completing the 5 km and 10 km running categories. The railway employees took part in the event despite their demanding operational schedules, which involve ensuring the safe movement of trains throughout the year.

stories.summary: 10pm. 58pm will run on the slow corridor till Thane before being re-diverted to the fast line at Mulund. 40 pm. 35pm on Sunday for maintenance of tracks, signalling and overhead equipment. Slow trains will run on fast lines during the block.

stories.title: Mumbai Navy Half Marathon draws over 22,000 runners from India and abroad
stories.summary: More than 22,000 runners, including 59 participants from 20 foreign countries, took part in the ninth edition of the Indian Oil WNC Navy Half Marathon 2026, organised by the Indian Navy in Mumbai on Sunday, November 22. The event began at Cross Maidan, with participants competing in three categories: the 21-km Aircraft Carrier Run, the 10-km Destroyer Run and the 5-km Frigate Run.

stories.title: Thief breaks into St Andrew’s Church, steals ₹15,000 in donation money
stories.summary: A thief broke into St Andrew’s Church in Bandra (west) and stole the cash from five donation boxes, leaving the local community shaken. According to the First Information Report (FIR) filed by parish priest Father Nigel Barrett, the theft took place between 11 pm on Friday and 5 am on Saturday after the burglar broke open a window and gained entry to the church.

stories.title: 30-Crore worth Musical Fountain Show to be developed at Powai lake
stories.summary: Mumbai ’s Powai Lake is set to become a major tourist attraction with the introduction of a ₹30-crore musical fountain and multimedia light-and-sound show celebrating the history of the Maratha Empire and the legacy of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. The project has been developed to enhance the city’s tourism infrastructure while offering visitors a combination of cultural storytelling and modern technology.

stories.title: BMC drops underground development at Mahalaxmi Racecourse
stories.summary: The civic administration has decided to scrap the ambitious underground component of the reimagined Mahalaxmi Racecourse plan, signalling a victory for urban planners and architects advocating for the city of Mumbai. While overground landscaped gardens and recreational spaces will remain part of the plan, Olympic-level sports facilities and a massive parking bay, which were to occupy two underground levels, have been dropped.

stories.title: Eight minors detained for assaulting couple in Kurla garden
stories.summary: A teenage couple was allegedly abused, assaulted and driven out of a municipal garden in Kurla by a group of boys on Friday evening, police said. The Ghatkopar police have detained eight minors in connection with the assault after a video of the incident surfaced on social media.

stories.title: Video call helped reassure family of four stranded on third floor of Mumbai Central building during midnight fire; eight rescued
stories.summary: A video call helped reassure a family of four, including two children, stranded on the upper floor of a three-storey building in Mumbai Central as fire raged below them shortly after midnight on Sunday. 07am. Fire brigade personnel, officers, a turntable ladder, an ambulance and other equipment were deployed.

stories.title: BMC Clears Mobile High-Mast Lights For Deonar Dumping Amid Corporators' Questions Over Availability, Cost Hike
stories.summary: With Deonar’s biomining and Waste-to-Energy projects yet to become operational, the BMC has approved vehicle-mounted high-mast lights to facilitate night-time dumping operations. However, the proposal came under fire at the recent Standing Committee meeting, with corporators questioning the equipment’s actual availability, necessity and a steep hike in contractor rates.

stories.title: 420-metre Poisar River stretch to get protective wall in ₹9 crore flood-control project
stories.summary: 08 crore to address recurring flooding in Hanuman Nagar, a low-lying locality that has witnessed flood-like situations during heavy rainfall over the past few years. Overflowing river water often inundates adjoining lanes and homes, disrupting daily life and making it difficult for residents to move around during the monsoon.

stories.title: Human Rights Complaint Filed Against Woman Constable For Allegedly Bursting Firecrackers Inside Andheri Police
stories.summary: Mumbai: A complaint has been filed with the Human Rights Commission against a woman police constable for allegedly bursting firecrackers inside the Andheri Police Station premises. Advocate Ashish Rai has lodged the complaint, alleging that the woman constable celebrated the transfer of a senior police inspector by bursting firecrackers inside the police station.

stories.title: Six sent to juvenile home after Mumbai assault; Maharashtra SP leader seeks age change
stories.summary: A juvenile court ordered that six persons in the 12- to 15-year-old age group be placed in a juvenile home until December 4, after Ghatkopar police detained eight persons below 18 in connection with an assault on a couple at Pramod Mahajan Garden in Kurla on Friday evening (November 20, 2026) and produced all eight before the Juvenile Justice Board, police said.

stories.title: At 16.2°C, Mumbai records its second-coldest November morning in a decade
stories.summary: 2°C, 5°C below normal, making it Mumbai’s second-coldest November morning in a decade. 7°C, recorded on November 30 last year. 3°C, recorded in 1950, according to the India Meteorological Department ( IMD ). 7°C below normal. stories.title: Mumbai Railway News: MRVC Adopts Advanced Soil Strengthening Technology To Expedite Borivali–Virar 5th And
stories.summary: Mumbai: In a move aimed at speeding up the long-pending expansion of Mumbai's suburban railway network, the Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation (MRVC) has introduced a specialised ground improvement technology to strengthen soft soil along the Dahisar–Mira Road stretch of the Borivali–Virar 5th and 6th line project.

stories.title: 67-year-old disabled man assaulted by four in Mumbai

When his daughter-in-law and grandsons intervened, they were allegedly assaulted by Salim, Ayaz and Sahil Min. Deoria was taken to Sion Hospital, where doctors diagnosed a spinal fracture.

stories.title: AIFF president Kalyan Chaubey calls for ‘mutual accountability’, says former officials should share reports of their tenures
stories.summary: AIFF president Kalyan Chaubey called for “mutual accountability” amidst growing concerns over Indian football, asking all those who have held positions of responsibility in the ecosystem to share reports of their respective tenures. Chaubey’s remarks came a day after former AIFF president Praful Patel expressed concern over the present state of Indian football.

stories.title: Kurla Couple Assault Case: Sanjay Nirupam Calls Incident 'Shameful', Demands Strict Action Against Minors
stories.summary: Shiv Sena leader Sanjay Nirupam on Sunday, November 22, reacted to the assault on a young couple by a group of minors inside Pramod Mahajan Garden near Phoenix Marketcity Mall in Kurla West, calling the incident "truly shameful" and raising concerns over the radicalisation of children in the area.

stories.title: Angry over breakup, Mumbai man pours petrol, sets ex-girlfriend's flat on fire in upscale locality
stories.summary: A youth allegedly set his former girlfriend's flat on fire in Dombivli after she decided to end their seven-year relationship. The accused allegedly poured petrol on the entrance door of the flat, where the woman lived with her parents, and set it ablaze.

stories.title: 8 killed, 2 injured as car rams into tree in Tamil Nadu
stories.summary: Eight people were killed and two others seriously injured after the car they were travelling in rammed into a neem tree in Tamil Nadu's Tiruchirappalli district on Sunday, police said.The accident occurred around 4.05pm near Kothurpatty Four Roads, within the limits of Jambunathapuram police station.The 10 occupants were returning to Thirukattupalli in Thanjavur district after attending an ear-piercing ceremony at Erumapatti in Namakkal district, police said.Five occupants died on the spot, while three others succumbed…

stories.title: FSSAI orders prosecution against Bisleri International for unsafe packaged drinking water
stories.summary: Food regulator FSSAI on Sunday (November 22, 2026) said it has sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri International, as it found its sample of packaged drinking water "unsafe". In a social media post, Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) said it has sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri International Pvt Ltd regarding "unsafe packaged drinking water".

stories.title: 3 killed, 33 injured as tractor-trolley carrying pilgrims overturns in MP
stories.summary: Around 35-36 villagers, including women and children, were travelling in the tractor-trolley. Several injured people suffered fractures and serious injuries to their heads and faces. Officials said the victims belonged to Gadhaula Gosai village under Bandri tehsil.

stories.title: Hyderabad Police Probe Hoax Threat Email Warning of 26/11-Like Attack
stories.summary: Hyderabad On High Alert After Email Threatens 26/11-Like Bomb Attacks | X @V6News Hyderabad : The city police on Sunday intensified security measures after an email claiming that bombs would go off at certain locations in the city was received. The email was sent to the city police id on November 21 and it seems to be a hoax, a police official told PTI.

stories.title: Raut alleges Rs 150 cr per MP to pass Delimitation Bill; BJP responds
stories.summary: Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut on Sunday accused the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) of attempting to buy MPs from other political parties to secure the numbers required to pass the proposed Delimitation Bill in Parliament. He alleged that the BJP was offering Rs 150 crore for each MP who switches sides, reported the IANS.

stories.title: Bengal BJP MLA Rekha Patra critical after suspected pesticide poisoning
stories.summary: Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) MLA from Hingalganj in West Bengal’s North 24 Parganas, Rekha Patra, was on Sunday (November 22, 2026) admitted to a private hospital in the city after falling ill from suspected pesticide poisoning. The MLA was admitted to Basirhat Subdivision Hospital, from where she was shifted to the private facility.

stories.title: BJP Rajya Sabha MP Ramrao Wadkute dies at 72
stories.summary: BJP Rajya Sabha lawmaker Ramrao Wadkute died of a heart attack at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) in New Delhi on Sunday. He was admitted to the hospital after complaining of chest pain. Wadkute, who hailed from Maharashtra’s Hingoli district, was known for his influence among the Dhangar community in the Marathwada region.

stories.title: Two Army personnel, wives and 3 children among 7 killed in Gujarat truck-car collision
stories.summary: Seven people, including two serving Indian Army personnel, their wives and three young children, were killed after their car was split in two in a head-on collision with a truck on the Bhuj-Khavda highway in Gujarat’s Kutch district on Saturday night, police said. The victims belonged to two families from Uttarakhand’s Garhwal region.

stories.title: YS Sharmila arrives at Bengaluru airport to visit family palace ahead of daughter's wedding, cops stop her
stories.summary: Karnataka police on Sunday prevented Andhra Pradesh Congress president YS Sharmila from proceeding to the disputed family palace in Yelahanka, Bengaluru, citing a court order restraining her from entering the property, people familiar with the development said. Sharmila arrived at Bengaluru airport in the evening along with her mother, YS Vijayamma, her son, Raja Reddy, and daughter-in-law, Priya Atluri.

stories.title: Hyderabad Police issue alert over terror threat email; security checks conducted at key locations
stories.summary: The Hyderabad Police issued a precautionary alert following a reported terror threat warning of possible bomb blasts at two locations in the city, including Hotel Tourist Plaza in Kacheguda and Kacheguda Railway Station. The sender also threatened to replicate the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks in Hyderabad. A senior police official told The Hindu that the message appeared to be a hoax.

stories.title: SpiceJet Crisis: Pilots’ Body Seeks Urgent Govt Intervention; Raises Concerns Over Flight Safety, Demands Airlines' Financial Surveillance
stories.summary: Mumbai: The Federation of Indian Pilots (FIP) has demanded the intervention of the union government into SpiceJet’s deepening operational crisis, warning that severe corporate financial distress directly compromises flight safety. The union has demanded a financial audit of the airline to ensure safe flight operations.

stories.title: 'Not Only Against Diljit Dosanjh': Professor Responds To Singer's 'Double Standards' Remark
stories.summary: Dr Punditrao Dharennavar, Associate Professor of Sociology at PGGC-46, Chandigarh, who sought restrictions over Diljit Dosanjh singing Patiala Peg, 5 Taara and Jeeb Vicho Feem Labbiya has rejected allegations of "double standards" over song lyrics. He has said that his objections are not limited to Diljit but extend to singers whose songs promote alcohol, drugs and gun culture.

stories.title: The decade India turned the tide on poverty
stories.summary: A year ago, during my visit to Kiphire, an aspirational district in the remote hills of Nagaland, I interacted with tribal women from local self-help groups. Among them was Esther, a Lakhpati Didi, who proudly spoke of her millet-based products reaching customers online, far beyond Nagaland. I encouraged them to dream bigger and become Crorepati Didis.

stories.title: Two men killed in separate hit-and-run cases
stories.summary: A 74-year-old pedestrian was killed after being knocked down by a two-wheeler on Santhome High Road on Saturday evening. The city traffic police said A. John, a resident of Kuyil Thottam in Mylapore, was returning home after visiting his son residing in Dummingkuppam. While trying to cross the Santhome High Road near the signal to go to Kutchery Road, John was hit by a two-wheeler coming from Kamarajar Salai.

stories.title: Maharashtra to upgrade 3,832 anganwadis with smart classrooms, modern kitchens
stories.summary: Maharashtra will upgrade 3,832 anganwadi centres across the state under a government initiative to improve infrastructure and provide children with better learning facilities, Women and Child Development Minister Aditi Tatkare said on Sunday. The centres will be equipped with e-learning tools, rainwater harvesting systems, modern kitchens and other facilities as part of the plan to develop them into smart anganwadis.

stories.title: Maharashtra scales down tree plantation drive amid severe drought, says Fadnavis
stories.summary: Maharashtra has scaled down its tree-plantation drive this year due to acute water shortages caused by severe drought conditions across several districts, Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis said on Saturday. Speaking at an event in the presence of spiritual leader Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev, Fadnavis said that 80-90 per cent of rural Maharashtra was facing drought and a severe water crisis.

stories.title: RJD supporters tear down posters near Nitish Setu inaugurated by PM Modi in Vaishali; 3 held
stories.summary: Hours after Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the six-lane Nitish Setu across the Ganga in Vaishali on Saturday, a group of people identified as Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD) supporters created a commotion on the newly inaugurated bridge.

stories.title: Kasimedu fisherfolk withdraw strike after Minister’s intervention
stories.summary: Fishermen of Kasimedu on Sunday withdrew their indefinite strike, seeking the release of eight boats impounded by the Andhra Pradesh government, after the intervention of Finance Minister N. Marie Wilson, who is also the MLA for Dr. Radhakrishnan Nagar Assembly constituency. The Minister, who reached the fishing harbour on Sunday morning, interacted with the leaders of various associations, and listened to their grievances for about an hour.

stories.title: "Anti-Hindu": BJP On Tamil Nadu Government's Deepam Order Review Plea
stories.summary: The BJP on Sunday said the Tamil Nadu government's move to seek a review of a Supreme Court order permitting the lighting of the traditional Karthigai Deepam lamp on November 24 as a one-time measure at Deepathoon reflects an "anti-Hindu and anti-Sanatan Dharma" mindset of the Congress and its allies.

stories.title: Centre prioritising border villages, 40 seeing reverse migration: Amit Shah in Arunachal Pradesh
stories.summary: Describing the development of border villages as a priority of the government, Union Home Minister Amit Shah on Sunday (November 22, 2026) said the upliftment of about 40 villages along the International Border in Arunachal Pradesh , under the Centre’s flagship Vibrant Villages Programme (VVP), ensured that many of those who moved out from these areas were returning.

stories.title: Eight killed as speeding minivan rams into roadside tree in Tamil Nadu's Tiruchirappalli
stories.summary: Eight people were killed and two others injured after a minivan lost control and rammed into a roadside tree in Tamil Nadu's Tiruchirappalli district on Sunday, police said. The incident took place at around 4 pm in Musiri, which is located about 350 km south of Chennai, an officer said.

stories.title: Manipur hooch tragedy toll rises to 17; sample sent to Kolkata lab
stories.summary: The death toll in Manipur’s hooch tragedy rose to 17 on Sunday (November 22, 2026), as the State government sent samples of the suspected spurious liquor produced locally to the National Food Laboratory in Kolkata for testing. Government spokesperson and MLA Thokchom Radheshyam Singh said 16 people who died after consuming the liquor were from Chandel district and one was from Kakching district.

stories.title: Rajasthan: Nine killed, several injured as vehicle carrying 16 pilgrims rams into parked truck in Kota
stories.summary: At least nine people were killed and several others injured after a vehicle carrying pilgrims rammed into a parked truck near Shambhupura on the Kota-Udaipur highway in Rajasthan''s Kota district, police said. According to Additional District Collector Rajesh Joshi, the vehicle was carrying 16 people who were returning to Maharashtra after visiting Khatu Shyam when the accident occurred in the middle of the night.

stories.title: Kaiga nuclear unit-1 attains criticality again, gets a second life
stories.summary: In a big milestone for the country’s nuclear sector, Kaiga Generating Station Unit-1 (KGS-1) in Karnataka successfully attained criticality early Sunday for the second time, giving a new lease of life to the nuclear power unit that had been taken offline for life-extension work after 25 years of operation.

stories.title: Man injured in crocodile attack near Chidambaram
stories.summary: A 42-year-old man sustained minor injuries on his left thigh after being bitten by a crocodile that strayed into a house in Koppadi village near Chidambaram on Sunday. According to police sources, P. Ilavarasan of Koppadi village was staying in his house when a dog began to bark continuously.

stories.title: Pune: FDA Suspends Amazon, BigBasket Dark Store Licences, 12 Drug Establishments Face Action
stories.summary: Pune: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA), Pune Division, has suspended the licences of two major quick-commerce dark stores operated by Amazon and BigBasket on Sinhagad Road for serious hygiene and food safety violations.

stories.title: Indian opposition party’s youth wing warns of more Meta protests after police clashes
stories.summary: The youth wing of India’s main opposition Congress party warned of more protests against Meta’s removal of some of its members’ ⁠accounts, ⁠a day after clashing with ​police outside the tech firm’s locals offices.

stories.title: Robert Pattinson owns $5.3 million mansion but lives in rentals with Suki
stories.summary: Robert Pattinson may be preparing to take on one of Hollywood's most iconic roles as the next James Bond, but his personal life is far from settled. The actor, who owns a multimillion-dollar mansion in Los Angeles with his fiancée Suki Waterhouse, is reportedly not living in the property.

stories.title: Hyderabad on alert after email threatens to avenge terrorist Lateef Bhat's killing
stories.summary: In response to a concerning threat email about a potential terror attack, Hyderabad police have stepped up security measures. The email, attributed to a group claiming vengeance for a terrorist's death, specifically named targets such as Hotel Tourist Plaza and Kachiguda railway station. While thorough searches have revealed no explosives, officials are diligently tracing the threat's origins and urging the public to remain alert.

stories.title: ‘Haven’t invited me to discuss Indus waters’: Pak minister Musadik Malik evades questions on IWT, ‘cut off hands’ remark
stories.summary: Pakistan minister Musadik Masood Malik said that Pakistan would discuss the Indus Waters Treaty (IWT) only when formally invited to do so, deflecting questions on the issue from reporters in Delhi. Malik also dodged questions about his earlier controversial “cut off hands” remark, avoiding a direct response to the matter.

stories.title: Explosion on Russian ship at Libya port caused by suspected drone attack, officials say
stories.summary: An explosion has occurred on a Russian ship docked at Benghazi naval base port after a suspected drone attack, Libya's eastern government has said. The explosion happened at dawn on Sunday, while the ship had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia, Libyan state media reported, citing the eastern government.

stories.title: ‘China working to suppress India’s rise, backed Pakistan after Operation Sindoor’: US panel’s report
stories.summary: China is actively working to suppress India’s rise across multiple domains as it understands New Delhi's growing strategic significance in the global power struggle, a report by the US-China Economic and Security Review Commission (USCC) released on November 18 has noted. It also added that Pakistan had China's backing during the military escalation with India following Operation Sindoor in May 2025.

stories.title: Cargo ship bound for Russia's Kaliningrad hit by drones, Finland tightens security
stories.summary: google Add Al Jazeera on Rescue efforts are under way in the Gulf of Finland after a Russian cargo ship was hit by drones close to Russia’s maritime border. The ship, the Sparta II, is on fire and has now drifted into Finnish territorial waters, authorities say.

stories.title: Nepal PM Balendra Shah arrives in Delhi for first official visit to India
stories.summary: The Prime Minister of Nepal, Balendra Shah, arrived here on Sunday (November 22, 2026) afternoon for his first official visit to India. Sources said that Mr. Shah will inaugurate several projects on Monday and is scheduled to hold talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi. According to sources, Monday’s (November 23, 2026) discussion between the two Prime Ministers will give “political direction” to bilateral relations for the coming years.

stories.title: Russian attack near Ukraine’s capital strikes apartment building, killing two and wounding four others
stories.summary: A Russian attack struck an apartment building in a village near Ukraine’s capital on Sunday (November 22, 2026), killing at least two people and wounding four others, authorities said. Nearly a dozen people were feared trapped beneath the rubble. The morning strike destroyed the five-storey building in Dymer, which is north of Kyiv.

stories.title: Liverpool 4-0 Manchester United: Five key takeaways for Pochettino
stories.summary: google Add Al Jazeera on If Mauricio Pochettino had any doubt about the size of the job in front of him at Manchester United, his players confirmed his worst fears within 13 minutes of his first game in charge – a 4-0 defeat at Liverpool.

stories.title: Longest UN Climate Climate Ends Without A Deal Over Fossil Fuels Deadlock
stories.summary: A standoff on a fossil fuel phase-out prevented countries at COP 31, the United Nations climate talks in Antalya, Turkiye, from achieving any consensus agreement on future climate action on Sunday (November 22, 2026), despite the conference running a record 48 hours into overtime. The European Union led objections to COP 31 President Murat Kurum’s consensus cover text that failed to include any explicit language about moving away from fossil fuels.

stories.title: What's next after no deal at COP31 climate talks?
stories.summary: Close The COP31 climate summit in Turkey has officially come to an end after countries failed to come to a consensus on a new deal. The European Union and some other countries rejected a fourth draft agreement over its failure to mention a need to phase out fossil fuels, the largest driver of global climate change.

stories.title: Man who killed three during psychotic episode ‘had been released after catalogue of failures’
stories.summary: A man with paranoid schizophrenia who killed three people while experiencing a psychotic episode had been released from custody after a “catalogue of failures” by police and medical professionals, an investigation has found. Alexander Lewis-Ranwell was arrested and released twice by police in the 48 hours before he killed Anthony Payne, 80, and the twin brothers Roger and Dick Carter, 84, in their homes in Exeter in 2019.

stories.title: Three killed and dozens missing after fire at Indonesian factory
stories.summary: At least three people have been killed and 36 are still missing after a fire at a confectionary factory in western Java on Saturday. Firefighters were still tackling some flames on Sunday, while rescuers searched for the missing in parts of the damaged building where workers were believed to be trapped.

stories.title: Italian jeweller and businessman Paolo Bulgari dies aged 89
stories.summary: Italian jeweller Paolo Bulgari, who helped turn his family's business into a global luxury brand, has died in Rome aged age 89. His family announced the news, remembering him as "the greatest jeweller of our time", according to Italian media. Paolo Bulgari was Chairman of the Bvlgari Group since 1984 and its jewellery pieces have adorned Hollywood stars and royalty including Diana, Princess of Wales.

stories.title: India-EU trade pact likely to be signed on December 16
stories.summary: India and the 27-nation bloc European Union (EU) are likely to sign the Free Trade Agreement (FTA) on December 16, an official said. The two sides concluded the negotiations for the pact on January 27 this year. European Union's Ambassador to India, Jean-Eric Paquet, recently said the FTA will be signed during Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi 's visit to Brussels in December, and it will come into force next year.

stories.title: Max Verstappen wins the Las Vegas Grand Prix for the third time in four years
stories.summary: Four time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen first held off George Russell and later Kimi Antonelli and Lando Norris on Saturday night to win a thrilling back-and-forth Las Vegas Grand Prix for the third time in four years. Verstappen started from the pole position, but was under pressure from the start before pulling away from Norris, the 2025 series champion, on the final lap.

stories.title: Russian cargo ship leaves Finland’s territorial waters after drone attack
stories.summary: google Add Al Jazeera on A Russian cargo ship struck by drones in the Gulf of Finland has left Finnish territorial waters after posing a “serious danger” there, according to Finland’s President Alexander Stubb.

stories.title: San Francisco braces for massive tides. Mayor urges residents to reconsider travel
stories.summary: Scattered rain continued to exacerbate the impacts of historic flooding across central Florida on Saturday, even as officials in Northern California braced for an unprecedented deluge during high tides heading into the heavy Thanksgiving travel week.

stories.title: Two Indian-origin residents of Delta killed in shooting outside Canada Walmart: Report

stories.title: Injured Jacks out of T20 Australia tour
stories.summary: England all-rounder Will Jacks has been ruled out of the rest of the tour of Australia with a broken hand. The 28-year-old was injured after four balls of the penultimate over as Australia took victory in the first T20 international in Melbourne on Saturday. Jacks was hurt trying to take a caught-and-bowled chance off Ben Dwarshuis.

stories.title: States agree to UN talks aiming to regulate 'killer robots' by 2028
stories.summary: ⁠UN talks on regulating weapons with little or no human oversight ended on Saturday (November 21, 2026) with a pledge for further discussions to develop new rules within two years, ‌an outcome weakened by Russia's opposition and disappointing human rights groups.
